title: Buy 2 Get 1 Free Is Costing You $1,700 a Year
hook: That 'free' item isn't free — 73% of BOGO shoppers only wanted one thing, and the math on what that habit costs you annually is brutal.
angle: BOGO deals feel like savings but trigger 28+ dollars of unplanned spending every trip — naming the psychology and the real annual cost flips the framing completely
audience: Anyone who grocery shops, goes to big-box stores, or buys anything on 'deal' — basically everyone
key_numbers: 73% — share of BOGO shoppers who only intended to buy one item
$1,700 — average annual overspend from BOGO impulse buys
$42 — what you spend buying 3 items at $14 each
$28 — how much more you spent than planned to 'save' $14
25-40% — extra profit retailers earn per transaction on BOGO deals
